title: 第11章  选我
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
卧室里，昏迷的姜知夏躺在床上，雌后目光担忧地站在床边。
姜淮和姜霆也在不远处，房间里，还有一排容貌各异的雄性。
这些全都是帝国贵族出身的适龄单身雄性。
今天姜琳本想借着接风宴安排他们露露脸，让女儿挑一挑。
结果倒好，姜淮把人灌醉了，还是被姜霆从后花园抱回来的。
姜琳揉了揉眉心，狠狠瞪了姜淮一眼。
姜淮心虚，不敢吱声。
在一众衣着华贵的贵族雄性中，苏尘一身白色礼服，看了看床上的姜知夏，站了出来。
“雌后，公主喝的酒并不烈，按理说不会醉到昏迷不醒的地步，不如让我看看？”
他今天也在受邀行列，只是没想到再见到三公主，是这种情形。
姜琳侧开身：“对，你来看看。”
苏尘是帝国最年轻的治疗师，医术精湛，有他看，姜琳也放心。
姜知夏就是在这时候醒的。
她还没从昏迷前的惊恐中退出来，刚睁开眼就看见一张脸凑近，下意识甩出去一巴掌：“啊啊啊！”
“啪！”
这个耳光结结实实打在苏尘脸上。
站在一旁的姜霆眉心一跳。
姜知夏打完人清醒过来，这才发现自己在皇宫卧室的床上。
她怎么在这儿？
再环顾四周，更懵了。

房间里怎么这么多人？
咦，这个好看的医生怎么会在这儿？
我，我刚才打的是他？
苏尘缓缓扭回头，表情平静到好像挨打的不是他一样，语气温和，“雌后，公主应该只是对酒精比较敏感，醒了就没事了。”
姜知夏意识到打错人了，想开口道歉，却被姜琳打断了。
“怎么喝醉了晕这么久？有没有不舒服？”
姜琳半点也不觉得女儿打人有什么不对，关切地看着她。
姜知夏定了定神，把涌到嘴边的话咽了回去。
那个变态能在皇宫里来去自如，肯定不简单。
现在房间里这么多人，难保不会是其中一个，她贸然说出来，万一打草惊蛇怎么办？
她摇了摇头：“我没事了母亲。”
说完，她歉疚地看向苏尘。
苏尘垂着眼，没有接收到。
姜琳松了口气，指着姜淮就骂：“都是你干的好事！姜霆，给我好好教训他！”
姜霆瞥了一眼姜淮那颗彩了吧唧的脑袋，淡淡道：“是。”
他一把拎起苦着脸的姜淮，转身就走。
姜淮哀嚎：“大哥！我明天还有拍摄，手下留情——”
声音渐渐远去。
房间里剩下的雄性们互相交换了下眼神。
没有人在乎苏尘莫名其妙挨打，谁都知道苏尘在家族里地位尴尬，细算起来连嫡系都算不上，挨公主一巴掌算什么？

他们在意的是另一件事：视频里这位公主说的那些话，是真是假？
看看那一巴掌……她会对正夫好？
只有底层雄性容易被那种话打动，他们可不傻。
于是，见姜知夏醒了，他们纷纷礼貌告退。
苏尘也准备离开。
“苏尘，”姜琳叫住他，“你再给公主仔细看看，我看她脸色还不太好。”
姜知夏确实脸色不好，不过是被那个变态吓得。
但听到“苏尘”这个名字，她整个人像被雷劈了一样，猛地抬起头。
谁？苏尘？！
那不是女主的男闺蜜吗？！
她记得女主回归后不久，和帝国的天才治疗师苏尘一见如故，两人一起合作研发了新型抑制剂，名噪一时。
可是……苏尘不是毁容了吗？
原剧情里，苏尘遇到女主的时候整张脸全是烧伤，还缺了一只耳朵，只佩戴面具示人。
至于原因，剧情根本没交代，只来来回回写女主是怎么嘘寒问暖地温暖他。
苏尘停住脚步，转身回来：“是，雌后。”
姜知夏盯着他那张好看的脸，完全和剧情对不上号。
姜琳对苏尘很放心，干脆站起身出去处理宾客。
姜琳离开后，房间里只剩下姜知夏和苏尘两人。
苏尘垂着眼，温声说：“公主，我用精神力探查一下您的身体，冒犯了。”
姜知夏点点头。

雄性的精神力虽然带有攻击力，但有些种族的攻击力并不强，精神力也可以被运用到别的方面，比如探测之类的。
苏尘显然就是后者。
她小声说：“那个，刚才对不起啊，我不是故意的……”
苏尘微微一笑，“没什么，您还有哪儿不舒服吗？”
看姜知夏摇头，他缓缓收回精神力，同时在心里重新衡量了一下。
被雄性的精神力在身体里探索都没半点反应，看来这位公主恐怕连C级都不是。
姜知夏尴尬得不知道手往放哪儿。
未来大佬不能得罪啊！
那一巴掌应该甩在变态脸上，而不是这个白衣天使脸上！
她再次诚恳地看着他，“真的对不起，这样吧，你想要什么补偿？只要我能做到的，我都答应你。”
苏尘垂下眼，看着床上仰起脸认真向他道歉的雌性。
他觉得有些好笑。
一个耳光而已，比这过分千百倍的事他都经历过，刚才是真的没放在心上。
可现在，他得到了真诚的道歉。
公主可能不知道，她这样做非但没有让他感动，反而激起了他的……贪心。
“公主说，任何补偿都可以？”
姜知夏眨眨眼：你要是要我命那我可不给。
苏尘静静地看了她几秒，突然单膝跪地。
这个动作让她吓了一跳，“你，你干嘛？”
苏尘抬起手，轻轻搭在她的手上握住。

“如果可以，我希望公主在各位雄性中挑选正夫时，能选我。”
姜知夏：“……嗯？”
宴会结束后，姜知夏坚持要回自己的私人别墅。
然后她就被迫坐上了大哥的悬浮车。
别问，问就是在任何时代背景下，也需要遵守喝车不开酒，开酒不喝车。
车里，姜知夏忍不住偷瞄大哥。
和苏尘那种透着温柔气质的脸不同，大哥这张脸啊，帅得毫无技巧，就是硬帅。
就是性格太冷了……这一路两人一句话都没说。
等到别墅门口，姜知夏抱着东西飞快下车。
姜霆这时候才开口。
他漆黑的眼睛看向她怀里的东西：“你喜欢吃？”
姜知夏愣了一下。
顺着他的目光看，这才哦了两声：“还不错，皇宫厨师做的味道好，外面买不到哈哈……”
怀里的是她从皇宫顺的蛋糕，拿回来喂陆决的。
姜霆沉默了一下，“嗯。”
姜知夏：“……？”
没等她搞明白大哥什么意思，车窗关闭，悬浮车飞了出去。
content_en:
In the bedroom, the unconscious Jiang Zhixia was lying on the bed, and the female queen stood beside the bed with worried eyes.
Jiang Huai and Jiang Ting were not far away, and there was a row of males with different looks in the room.
These are all single males of the right age who come from imperial nobles.
Today Jiang Lin wanted to arrange for them to show their faces through the Jie Feng Banquet and let her daughter have a choice.
The result was good, Jiang Huai got the man drunk, but Jiang Ting carried him back from the back garden.
Jiang Lin rubbed her eyebrows and glared at Jiang Huai.
Jiang Huai felt guilty and did not dare to say anything.
Among the luxuriously dressed aristocratic males, Su Chen, dressed in a white dress, looked at Jiang Zhixia on the bed and stood up.
"Queen, the wine the princess drank was not strong. It stands to reason that she would not be drunk to the point of unconsciousness. Why don't you let me take a look?"
He was also invited today, but he didn't expect to see the third princess again in this situation.
Jiang Lin turned sideways: "Yes, come and take a look."
Su Chen is the youngest therapist in the empire and has superb medical skills. Jiang Lin can feel at ease with him.
Jiang Zhixia woke up at this time.
She hadn't recovered from the panic before she fell into coma. As soon as she opened her eyes, she saw a face approaching and subconsciously slapped her: "Ahhh!"
"Crack!"
This slap hit Su Chen firmly on the face.
Jiang Ting, who was standing aside, frowned.
Jiang Zhixia woke up after beating the man and found herself on the bed in the palace bedroom.
Why is she here?
Looking around again, I was even more confused.
Why are there so many people in the room?
Hey, why is this good-looking doctor here?
Me, was he the one I hit just now?
Su Chen slowly turned his head, his expression calm as if he wasn't the one who was being beaten, and his tone was gentle, "Queen, the princess is probably just more sensitive to alcohol. She'll be fine when she wakes up."
Jiang Zhixia realized that she had hit the wrong person and wanted to apologize, but was interrupted by Jiang Lin.
"Why did you faint for so long after being drunk? Are you feeling uncomfortable?"
Jiang Lin didn't think there was anything wrong with her daughter hitting someone at all, and looked at her with concern.
Jiang Zhixia calmed down and swallowed back the words that came to her mouth.
It's certainly not easy for that pervert to be able to come and go freely in the palace.
There were so many people in the room now, and there was no guarantee that it wouldn't be one of them. She said it rashly, what if she alerted someone?
She shook her head: "I'm fine, mother."
After saying that, she looked at Su Chen apologetically.
Su Chen lowered his eyes and did not receive it.
Jiang Lin breathed a sigh of relief, pointed at Jiang Huai and scolded: "It's all your fault! Jiang Ting, teach him a lesson!"
Jiang Ting glanced at Jiang Huai's colorful head and said calmly: "Yes."
He picked up the grimacing Jiang Huai, turned around and left.
Jiang Huai wailed: "Brother! I have filming tomorrow, please be merciful——"
The sound faded away.
The remaining males in the room exchanged glances with each other.
No one cared that Su Chen was beaten inexplicably. Everyone knew that Su Chen had an embarrassing status in the family. In total, he was not even a direct descendant. What was a slap from the princess?
What they care about is another thing: Are the words said by the princess in the video true or false?
Look at that slap... Will she be kind to her husband?
Only low-level males are easily moved by such words, and they are not stupid.
So, seeing Jiang Zhixia awake, they all politely excused themselves.
Su Chen was also ready to leave.
"Su Chen," Jiang Lin called to him, "take a closer look at the princess. I think her face is not very good."
Jiang Zhixia did have a bad look on her face, but she was just frightened by that pervert.
But when she heard the name "Su Chen", she suddenly raised her head as if she had been struck by lightning.
who? Su Chen? !
Isn't that the heroine's male best friend? !
She remembered that not long after the heroine returned, she hit it off with the empire's genius therapist Su Chen, and the two worked together to develop a new inhibitor and became famous for a while.
But... wasn't Su Chen disfigured?
In the original plot, Su Chen met the heroineAt that time, his entire face was covered with burns and one ear was missing. He only wore a mask to show off.
As for the reason, the plot didn't explain it at all. It just went back and forth about how the heroine warmed him by asking after her.
Su Chen stopped and turned back: "Yes, the female queen."
Jiang Zhixia stared at his beautiful face, which was completely out of line with the plot.
Jiang Lin felt relieved about Su Chen and simply stood up and went out to deal with the guests.
After Jiang Lin left, only Jiang Zhixia and Su Chen were left in the room.
Su Chen lowered his eyes and said warmly: "Princess, I used my mental power to explore your body. I'm offended."
Jiang Zhixia nodded.
Although male mental power has offensive power, the attack power of some races is not strong, and mental power can also be used in other aspects, such as detection.
Su Chen is obviously the latter.
She whispered: "Um, I'm sorry just now, I didn't mean to..."
Su Chen smiled slightly and said, "It's nothing. Are you feeling uncomfortable anywhere else?"
Seeing Jiang Zhixia shaking his head, he slowly withdrew his mental power and re-evaluated it in his mind.
She didn't even react at all when the male's mental power was being explored in her body. It seemed that this princess was not even C-level.
Jiang Zhixia was so embarrassed that she didn't know where to put her hands.
The future boss cannot be offended!
That slap should be on the face of the pervert, not on the face of this angel in white!
She looked at him sincerely again, "I'm really sorry, so be it. What compensation do you want? As long as I can do it, I will promise you."
Su Chen lowered his eyes and looked at the female on the bed who raised her face and apologized to him seriously.
He found it a bit funny.
It was just a slap in the face. He had experienced things a thousand times worse than this. He really didn't take it to heart just now.
But now, he got a sincere apology.
The princess may not know that instead of moving him, her doing so aroused his... greed.
"The princess said, any compensation is acceptable?"
Jiang Zhixia blinked: If you want my life, I won't give it to you.
Su Chen looked at her quietly for a few seconds, then suddenly knelt down on one knee.
This action startled her, "You, what are you doing?"
Su Chen raised his hand, gently placed it on her hand and held it.
"If possible, I hope that when the princess chooses a husband among all the males, she can choose me."
Jiang Zhixia: "...huh?"
After the banquet, Jiang Zhixia insisted on going back to her private villa.
Then she was forced to sit on her eldest brother's hover car.
Don't ask, just ask. In any era, you need to abide by the rules of drinking a car but not driving, and driving a drink but not driving a car.
In the car, Jiang Zhixia couldn't help but peek at her elder brother.
Different from Su Chen's face that exuded a gentle temperament, the eldest brother's face was so handsome that he had no skills at all, he was just tough and handsome.
It's just that their personalities are too cold... The two of them didn't say a word during the entire journey.
When Jiang Zhixia arrived at the door of the villa, she quickly got out of the car holding her things.
Only then did Jiang Ting speak.
His dark eyes looked at the things in her arms: "Do you like to eat?"
Jiang Zhixia was stunned for a moment.
Following his gaze, he said, "It's not bad. The food made by the palace chef tastes good. You can't buy it outside. Haha..."
What she held in her arms was the cake she brought back from the palace to feed Lu Jue.
Jiang Ting was silent for a moment, "Yeah."
Jiang Zhixia: "...?"
Before she could figure out what her elder brother meant, the car window closed and the hover car flew out.
